users.password_hash: bcrypt cost12 unique salt; never exported

sessions.token_hash: SHA256 of random256bit session primary key; never exported

tables.plans.owner_id: nullable users.id FK; null legacy plans quarantined, no public access; new plans always use session user

experiment_days.date: actual Seoul today; unique per experiment

authorization: server session identity only; every parent/child read and write checks plans.owner_id; client owner identifiers ignored; anonymous401; foreign404
cookie: production __Host-move_session, Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/ Max-Age=86400; token not in URL or browser JS
revocation: logout deletes current session; password change increases auth_version and deletes all sessions; deletion removes account and all personal records
observation: exactly five distinct actual Seoul dates; no backfill; no fictitious actual data; after second entry before third change one plan rule; fixed metric/unit/calculation
legacyMigration: production had zero rows in all T06 tables when checked; user confirmed no data; no first-signup auto-claim
export: own diary + own observation only; never password_hash, sessions or auth_attempts
